intended_rationale: Operating trim exceeds the permitted ice trim.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: The draught and trim, limited by the UIWL, must not be exceeded when the ship is navigating in ice. The salinity of the sea water along the intended route shall be taken into account when loading the ship.

contract.comparisonModel: The draught and trim, limited by the UIWL, must not be exceeded when the ship is navigating in ice. The salinity of the sea water along the intended route shall be taken into account when loading the ship.

proof.meaning: Under navigatingInIce=true, the first SELECT compares operating draught/trim with UIWL/maximum trim. The separate salinity SELECT tests loading versus intended-route salinity in the canonical salinity unit. Only the reported query and its corresponding field are admitted.
